anna.sales: Handoff: NimbusHealth trial (acct NH-44). Signed POC for dedicated cluster in eu-west1. Main concerns: SSO via Okta, data residency, and renewal sensitivity (POC budget limited). They need onboarding in 7 days. Can CS pick up?

maria.cs: Picking up. Anna, did they provide IdP metadata and certs? Also do they have a preferred test dataset for PHI-like content?

anna.sales: Contact is joe@nimbus.health. They uploaded IdP metadata but got a cert chain error. Test data: small de-identified dataset provided. Budget note: they'll evaluate renewal if SLA meets <100ms median and <800ms p95 for embeddings during batch jobs.

kevin.ops: I'll create infra task to request dedicated pool and EU peering. Need to know expected throughput (rps) and max sequence length.

anna.sales: Peak expected ~20 qps, seq len up to 1024.

akash.eng: For the cert error, ENG ticket ENG-2210 opened. Likely intermediate cert missing. Ask Joe to share the raw metadata XML and cert thumbprint. For embeddings p95 target: we can tune batching and use quantized model variant. Will coordinate with ops for batch windows.

claire.se: Preparing a short enablement checklist and template config. I'll also prepare renewal risk flags to track in the account health dashboard.

kevin.ops: Created CS ticket CS-7801 and linked ENG-2210. Owners: maria.cs (CS), kevin.ops (ops), akash.eng (ENG), claire.se (SE). Scheduled onboarding call Fri 9am CET.

maria.cs: Action items: 1) Verify IdP metadata before call, 2) provision workspace + sample notebook, 3) run initial latency test and report to customer, 4) annotate account with renewal-risk=high until SLA met. I'll post updates in CS-7801.

anna.sales: Joe confirmed Fri 9am CET works. Thanks team.
